messages:
Tom H: Quick favor — can someone grab an nsys capture for the 2k-token benchmark (rwi/opt-13b-q4a) on the ded cluster? Daily p99 spiked to ~1.2s, want to compare to last week's run.

Maya S: I can do it today. Which run script and env did you use? batch=8? fp16? Any KV cache warmup steps?

Tom H: batch=8, seq=2048, fp16, warmup=3 iters then 20 iters sample. Run command is `python -u bench/infer.py --model rwi/opt-13b-q4a --seq 2048 --batch 8 --dtype fp16 --iters 23`.

Ethan L: For nsys, capture with CUDA + cuDNN traces and NVTX. Example we've been using:
```
nsys profile -o /tmp/bench_opt13b --trace=cuda,cudnn,nvtx --sample=none \
  --capture-range=nvtx --capture-range-start="bench:start" --capture-range-end="bench:end" \
  python -u bench/infer.py ...
```
That limits size and focuses on the warmed region.

Maya S: Good call. Also add `--sample=none` to avoid sampling bloat and use capture-range NVTX markers (we already instrument the runner with `bench:start`/`bench:end`).

Riya K: If you want a lightweight flamegraph for ops, after converting `nsys` -> `trace.json` you can run `nsys stats -i output.qdrep --format json` then our flameplot script `scripts/ops_flame.py trace.json > flame.svg` and upload. I can run the script if you drop the QDREP in `s3://redwood-profiling/benchmarks/1843210987/`.

Tom H: Thanks — Maya can you capture and upload to `s3://redwood-profiling/benchmarks/1843210987/opt13b/`? Please scrub any keys and add the qdrep + small README with exact cmd line.

perf-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-profiling/benchmarks/1843210987/opt13b/opt13b_run.qdrep :rocket:

Maya S: Uploaded qdrep + README (link above). I also attached `nsys-report.html` and a torch.profiler trace snippet.

Ethan L: Quick check — when you convert, use `nsys export --format=sqlite --output=...` so the flame tool can parse faster. I'll run the flameplot and post the svg here.

Tom H: Awesome — once Ethan posts the svg I will diff against last week's svg to see ops regressions. If we spot a specific op blowup I'll open a perf bug and assign.

Riya K: FYI, if you need torch profiler next time, small snippet:
```
with torch.profiler.profile(activities=[ProfilerActivity.CPU, ProfilerActivity.CUDA], record_shapes=True, with_stack=True) as prof:
  model(inputs)
prof.export_chrome_trace('torch_prof_trace.json')
```
Works well for operator-level attribution.

Maya S: noted. @Tom H I'll ping you once I have the final flame.svg and perf notes. :thumbsup:

Tom H: Thanks everyone :pray:
